name: Zwinger, Dresden
_about: THE ZWINGER, Dresden (Poeppelmann and Permoser, 1710-28; the Sempergalerie 1847-55), after OpenStreetMap and the 1755 plans: the court with its apsidal ends, lawns and four basins; the Langgalerie either side of the Kronentor and the four Bogengalerien, one-storey halls whose roofs are the terraces walked all round the court behind balustrades with statues and vases; the four corner pavilions with their stairs to the upper halls, the Wallpavillon with its grand stair and Hercules, the Glockenspielpavillon with the porcelain bells; the Kronentor over the bridge across the Zwingergraben; the Nymphenbad with its cascade; the Sempergalerie with its domed arch, its halls and stairs; the rampart. Generated by tools/archgen/zwinger.py. +x toward the Glockenspielpavillon, +z toward the Kronentor.
